title: The Smiling Cellar
author: Isandro Ashgrove
blurb: Jude Coldharbour, a hospice nurse who hears the dying count backwards, has spent twenty years telling themselves the noises have explanations. But when the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must finish the ritual the founders started before the last resident signs the papers.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
